answer.book: Goclenius, De vita prorogada (Mainz 1608): a single printed Latin treatise on preserving health, preceded by dedications and verses and followed by an alphabetical index. The treatise is divided into a short introduction of numbered quaestiones, then Caput I–XXI on air, food, drink and related matter, with quaestiones inside Caput III.
